messages.subject: Smoother plots with dygraphs
parts:
Hi, according to the author of dygraphs, it is possible to smooth the plots in dygraphs with an extra javascript (http://dygraphs.com/tests/smooth-plots.html).

But I do not succeed in make it work in my shiny dashboard app. I have been trying to use custom plotters (http://rstudio.github.io/dygraphs/gallery-custom-plotters.html) but no result.

Is there anybody who can help me and/or have a working example ?

Thanks
